Primary request: create one exact 4-column by 2-row sprite sheet containing eight genuinely different chronological animation poses for the Silent Librarian's forbidden-book echo skill.

Top row, left to right: (1) compact sealed grimoire held upright, dark and dormant; (2) bronze clasps cracking as thin corpse-cyan runes ignite; (3) book half-opening with several distinct pages lifting and ink threads gathering; (4) fully open book releasing a sharp restrained ivory/cyan rune pulse and a few page splinters.
